source_focus_allocation.note: Query attention allocation only; source identity remains unknown until reviewed.

notes: The target is 50+ individual source-lead briefs when results support it; no padding or invented incidents.
Bangladesh queries are prioritized, followed by South Asia and MENA.
Public social posts and rumours are included when indexed and surfaced by the provider, but remain unverified leads.
No fixed Telegram channel list defines report coverage; configured channels are only one discovery input.
Date filters narrow publication search results but do not prove the underlying incident occurred on that date.
Platform indexing and APIs do not provide universal coverage.
